headline: Dallas Baptist get past UCCS and stay unbeaten
dek: Eighteen wins and two draws now stand on Dallas Baptist's record, and no side has beaten them. Nova Southeastern are the only other programme in the division still without a defeat.
displaced_by: results night: Dallas Baptist beat UCCS and are still one of only two unbeaten sides in the division, with Nova Southeastern
